_doc: Production tool pins (md5 of the binary). A tool whose md5 differs is a DIFFERENT BUILD: the hub AppImage tracer (06f68444...) gives different areas than the fleet kit (1.668 vs 1.638 cm2 on one seed, source docs/experiments/vast_benchmark_2026-10-06/STATE.md s2), so an unpinned box silently changes geometry. The runner refuses to start on a mismatch unless --allow-unpinned is given, and then ANNOUNCES it and records it in the manifest.
